comment: zap.c makewish() with the `m` prefix (6334), wish_history_add() (6224-6253) and wish_history_menu() (6270-6307). Four wishes fill the history: an object, a terrain wish (the hands_obj arm, 6374-6377), an upper-case repeat that strncmpi() matches and so skips, and a second object. The first `m` ^W picks the oldest entry from the newest-first menu; the second cancels with Escape, which leaves the line empty so readobjnam() picks a random object.
